Mission.headline: Kāore te karere e rerekē. Ko te āhua o te mātakitaki a te tangata ka rerekē.
Mission.intro: Kei te hanga anō mātou i tā mātou kohinga ataata me ā mātou taputapu mai i te pūtake, e kawe ana i ngā tekau tau o te mahi whakamāori ki ngā tūāpapa e huihui ai, e mātakitaki ai, e tiritiri ai te tangata.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Te kohinga kiriata kua tino whakamāoritia rawa i te ao
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Nā ngā tekau tau o te mahi whakamāori, i kawea e ngā hoa minita pono, kua hangaia he kohinga me ngā mano ara reo, kia tūtaki ai te tangata ki te kōrero mō Ihu i te reo e tino pā hōhonu ana ki a ia.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Te kawe i ngā reo pono ki ngā hōputu hou
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Kei te hanga anō mātou i te āhua o te kōrerotanga ā-ataata o ngā kōrero Rongopai, e hono ana i ngā whakamāoritanga pono ki ngā hōputu hou, kia rere noa ai te karere puta noa i ngā tūāpapa, i ngā ahurea, i ngā mata hoki.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Nui atu i te kohinga. He rōpū e akiakihia ana e te mīhana.
Mission.teamPointDescription: He rōpū ā-ao a Jesus Film Project o ngā kaiwhakamāori, ngā tohunga pāpāho, ngā ētita me ngā kaihanga, e huri ana i ngā tekau tau o te wheako minita hei taputapu mā te hunga whakaako ākonga i ngā wāhi katoa.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Ko tā mātou e hanga ake nei
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Te hono i ngā kaimātakitaki ki ngā whai wāhitanga tūturu i tō rātou haerenga wairua, hei āwhina i a rātou ki te hīkoi whakamua ki te hapori, ki te Karaipiture, ki te mīhana rānei.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: He kohinga pāpāho Karaitiana whānui, me ngā mano ataata, kiriata, rauemi hoki e wātea ana i ngā reo maha, mō te minita me te kauwhau Rongopai puta noa i te ao.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Ngā Taputapu Matihiko mō ngā Minita
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Te whakahaere ataata, te tohatoha ihirangi, te whakawhitiwhiti ki te hunga mātakitaki, me te tātaritanga, i hangaia hei āwhina i ngā minita kia toro atu ki te tokomaha ake o te tangata, kia whai hua ai.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Āwhina ki te hanga i {accent} o ngā taputapu mīhana
Mission.inviteBody: Kei te pōwhiri mātou i ngā kaimahi, ngā kaihanga me ngā hoa mahi ki te uru wawe. Whakamātauria tuatahi ngā taputapu hou, tukua he urupare, ā, āwhina ki te waihanga i ngā hua i hangaia mō te mahi mīhana tūturu.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Ka whakatuwhera i te whārangi mīhana o Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Ka whakatuwhera i te whārangi mīhana o Jesus Film ki te wāhanga mahere ara
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Ka whakatuwhera i te rēhita beta i tō pūtirotiro
